verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships a scriptable CLI and documented pre-commit/pre-receive hooks (e.g. `trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --fail`) that could be invoked by any automated workflow, including one triggered by a coding agent before it commits code, and flags like --include-detectors/--fail support scripted gating. However, there is no evidence of an agent-specific integration (no MCP server, IDE/agent plugin, or documented recipe for wiring into Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code style agents) — the story's 'coding agent' framing is only inferable from generic pre-commit tooling, not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent integration docs/examples, an MCP or agent-hook interface, and any hands-on report of it being used inside an agent pipeline.
